methodological_rigor.justification: The study integrates multi-modal evidence: RNAscope, RT-qPCR, immunoblotting, ATAC-seq, H3K27ac ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag, RNA-seq, ABC enhancer-promoter modeling, Capture-C re-analysis, snATAC-seq (Cicero co-accessibility), eQTL analysis with TCGA KIRC/KIRP/KICH, CRISPR/Cas9 enhancer and TF knockouts, luciferase reporter assays, xenograft tumor models (NOD/SCID-gamma), and integration of published CRISPRi screens. The Erlangen cohort (141 tumors) and TCGA cohorts (KIRC n=72, KIRP n=31, KICH n=23) provide orthogonal patient-level validation. Controls include primary tubule cells, VHL re-expression (RCC4/i.VHL-HA), and non-targeting sgRNAs. Statistical analyses use DESeq2 with BH correction, Bonferroni post-hoc ANOVA, and Spearman rank correlation. The work is rigorous and convergent across modalities.

clinical_relevance_loe.justification: The study defines a novel HIF-EPAS1 auto-regulatory feed-forward enhancer circuit in ccRCC, with clear translational implications because HIF-2α inhibitors (belzutifan) are approved for VHL-disease and advanced RCC, and preclinical data suggest higher HIF-2α mRNA predicts sensitivity (cited refs 17, 18). The mechanism may inform patient stratification and explain GWAS signals at EPAS1. However, no clinical trial or patient-outcome data are presented. Level of evidence 5 (basic/mechanistic). Clinical impact is plausible but indirect.

reporting_quality.justification: The animal xenograft experiments follow ARRIVE-compatible practices: license number (55.2.2-2532-2-2150-19), randomization of injection order, blinded caliper measurements, age-matched littermates, both sexes, specified housing, pre-specified tumor volume limit (1 cm^3). The methods section is extensive and reproducible with tool versions, cell line sources, and parameters. A Nature Portfolio Reporting Summary is referenced. Supplementary Data 1-15 are extensively referenced (suggesting thorough data sharing), although specific public repository accession numbers for the new sequencing data (RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, H3K27ac ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag) are not visible in the extracted text — this is a reporting gap.

novelty_literature.justification: The paper identifies a novel, ccRCC-specific EPAS1 enhancer (~70 kb upstream; element KIRC_10770) activated by HIF itself, establishing an auto-regulatory feed-forward HIF-2α mRNA circuit and interaction with renal lineage-specific transcription factors (PAX8, HNF-1β). This explains the long-standing puzzle of why HIF-2α mRNA is elevated specifically in ccRCC versus papillary/chromophobe RCC, and ties together GWAS SNPs (rs12617313) with chromatin state. The combination of ABC modeling, snATAC-seq co-accessibility, CRISPR enhancer knockout, and eQTL analysis represents a first-in-class mechanistic synthesis for this locus.

writing_presentation.justification: The manuscript is clearly organized with a detailed introduction framing the unresolved question, a methods section that covers many techniques in depth, and results progressing from patient cohorts to cell lines to mechanistic experiments. Figures are complex but interpretable with multi-track visualizations. Minor writing issues include some awkward phrasing and very dense paragraphs. The extracted version has some redacted URLs. Overall publication-ready quality.

key_strengths: Multi-modal integration of ATAC-seq, H3K27ac ChIP-seq, CUT&Tag, RNA-seq, ABC modeling, snATAC-seq co-accessibility, and xenografts in both primary patient cells and established lines (RCC4, 786-0)
Novel ccRCC-specific EPAS1 enhancer (KIRC_10770) defined with orthogonal lines of evidence and functionally validated by CRISPR knockout and reporter assays
Mechanistic dissection of HIF auto-regulation at EPAS1 resolving a long-standing field question
Integration of GWAS SNP rs12617313 with eQTL and epigenetic data provides human-genetic grounding
Appropriate controls including VHL re-expression (RCC4/i.VHL-HA doxycycline inducible) and HIF-1β knockout
Large Erlangen patient cohort (141 tumors) plus orthogonal TCGA analyses
key_concerns: Sequencing data accession numbers for new RNA-seq, ATAC-seq, CUT&Tag, ChIP-seq are not visible in the extracted text
Correlation between H3K27ac signal and EPAS1 expression in Yao et al. subset missed statistical significance (R=0.62, p=0.06, n=10), weakening one supporting claim
Xenograft experiments details are limited in the extracted text; effect size on tumor growth from enhancer knockout is not described in available portions
Clinical translation (e.g., correlation with belzutifan response) is hypothesized but not tested
Feed-forward circuit evidence is strong for HIF but partial (incomplete mechanistic detail) for PAX8/HNF-1β interaction
chief_reviewer.rationale: A rigorous multi-omics mechanistic study establishing a novel EPAS1 enhancer and feed-forward HIF-2α regulation in ccRCC; tier 2 (Nature Communications / Cancer Research / Clinical Cancer Research scope) is defensible with minor revisions addressing data availability and xenograft reporting. Tier 1 would need direct therapeutic or clinical outcome integration.
